reviewed_reconciliation.original_create_job: Matches OpenAPI's eight required fields, enums, no-null/no-default behavior and additionalProperties=false. Keeps owner_id and workflow selector out of request body. B02's stricter body, UTF-8, depth, duplicate-key, scalar-identifier, artifact-availability and semantic-payload policies are explicit and do not alter the original DTO.
reviewed_reconciliation.job_and_receipt_dtos: Matches the exact Job, JobList, Snapshot, CommandReceipt, CommandStatus and Error field sets and nullability. Job omits project_id/title; workflow_version maps to the validated immutable registry ID; new acceptance stays DRAFT/accepted with nullable fields as specified.
reviewed_reconciliation.original_limit_default: The supplemental contract deliberately chooses original OpenAPI default25 and range1..100. It names the conflicting B02 paragraph default20 rather than silently resolving it; the implementation/test oracle must cite this reviewed supplemental correction.
reviewed_reconciliation.snapshot_initial_projection: Snapshot includes required job/steps/last_event_id. For this initial-only DRAFT state, steps=[] and last_event_id='' are valid under the original string schema and are expressly documented as an empty sentinel, not a fabricated event ID. Activation is held for B03/B04 event projection.
reviewed_reconciliation.outbox_mapping: Normalized schema mapping preserves all conceptual outbox information by joins/derivation: scope and actor/project/job/route from commands, payload_hash/status from commands, dispatch state from commands_outbox.state, expected_revision=0 for a new job. The existing command_payload_json retains full semantic payload. No added migration is required for this accepted initial state.
reviewed_reconciliation.cursor: Uses only the original cursor/limit query parameters, fixes actor/route/scope, and rejects unknown/repeated query fields. Cursor error mapping and sort/page behavior are concretely specified; default direction and concurrent insert behavior are explicit.
reviewed_reconciliation.authorization: Active membership request.create gates creation; active membership plus owner or live job.read delegation gates reads. Delegations are per-job/read-only; no implicit administrator inheritance. Existing schema uniqueness/FKs and column-limited grants support this, with operator setup separate from user API.
reviewed_reconciliation.artifacts_and_eligibility: CreateJob cannot upload or grant. Supplied artifact UUIDs must already be available, same-project and caller-owned. Catalog compare, mode/enabled/completeness and current grant validity are explicit; replay bypasses current profile availability/eligibility only after authorizing the original resource.
reviewed_reconciliation.idempotency_and_transaction: The original actor/route/key unique arbiter is used; same payload replays original receipt, different payload conflicts after authorization. Exact unique-constraint recovery rolls back attempted rows and scopes a fresh replay transaction to one project. Guard-first then membership FOR UPDATE NOWAIT addresses the existing trigger lock inversion; READ COMMITTED separate fresh authority reads and post-lock clock sampling address stale snapshots/time. Capture remains outside DB transactions.
reviewed_reconciliation.scope: Retains original job API and durable accepted-command slice. Workflow execution, workspace filesystem, artifact ingress, device routes, UI, corporate SSO and complete AT-21 are explicitly excluded.

nonblocking_clarifications.note: For independent implementations to emit byte-identical cursors, spell out the exact canonical JSON serialization (UTF-8/ensure_ascii, key order, compact separators, timestamp representation) before cursor tests are frozen. The contract does specify payload fields, HMAC domain, encoding, and validation, so this is a test-oracle precision improvement rather than a route/scope blocker.

The mock grant/revoke CLI defines output shape and exit classes but calls an error a fixed authority error without naming each public code/status. Pin literal codes for validation, unknown/cross-project grant, real-mode denial, and dependency failure before independent CLI tests are frozen.

The mock grant CLI requires nonempty evidence_ref without C0/DEL, but does not say whether escaped lone surrogates are rejected. As PostgreSQL UTF-8 TEXT cannot store lone surrogates and CreateJob's exceptional surrogate policy is field-specific, specify evidence_ref as Unicode scalar text before implementation.

The source-pinned preimplementation risk matrix still states default20 and labels cursor mapping/page behavior unresolved. This contract explicitly corrects/resolves those points; keep this reviewed contract authoritative and update the TC ledger/risk-matrix reference before freezing its cases so stale text cannot become an oracle.
